text: Supplier shall deliver the custom wiring harnesses to Buyer's designated receiving facility in accordance with the delivery schedule set out in Schedule 2, and time of delivery shall be of the essence. Should Supplier reasonably anticipate that a shipment will be delayed beyond the scheduled delivery date, Supplier shall notify Buyer in writing within 5 days of becoming aware of the anticipated delay, specifying the revised delivery date and the cause of the delay. Partial shipments shall be permitted only with Buyer's prior written consent, and each partial shipment shall be separately invoiced. Risk of loss shall pass to Buyer upon confirmed receipt at the designated facility, and Supplier shall retain risk of loss for all goods in transit prior to that point. Title to the goods shall pass to Buyer upon full payment of the applicable invoice, notwithstanding the earlier passage of risk of loss, and Supplier shall retain a purchase money security interest in the goods until such payment is received in full. Supplier shall maintain adequate insurance covering loss or damage to goods in transit and shall provide evidence of such coverage to Buyer upon reasonable written request.

Supplier warrants that the precision-machined aluminum housings delivered under this Agreement shall, for a period of thirty (30) days from the date of delivery, conform to the specifications set out in Schedule 1 and shall be free from defects in material and workmanship under normal use and service. This warranty does not extend to defects arising from misuse, unauthorized modification, or normal wear and tear. Buyer's sole and exclusive remedy for breach of this warranty shall be, at Supplier's option, repair, replacement, or refund of the purchase price for the nonconforming goods, provided that Buyer notifies Supplier in writing within 14 days of discovering the defect. Supplier shall bear the cost of shipping any repaired or replacement goods to Buyer, and Buyer shall grant Supplier reasonable access to inspect the nonconforming goods prior to any repair, replacement, or refund. This warranty is in lieu of all other warranties, express or implied, including any implied warranty of merchantability or fitness for a particular purpose, except as expressly set out in this Clause.

Prices for the precision-machined aluminum housings are as set out in Schedule 1 and are denominated in EUR unless otherwise agreed in writing. Supplier shall invoice Buyer upon shipment, and payment shall be due forty-five (45) days from the date of each invoice. Should Buyer fail to make payment when due, Supplier may, upon 14 days' prior written notice, suspend further deliveries until all outstanding amounts, together with accrued interest, have been paid in full, without prejudice to any other rights or remedies available to Supplier. Any change in prices shall require not less than 14 days' prior written notice to Buyer and shall apply only to purchase orders placed after the effective date of the change. All invoices shall be issued in EUR and shall separately state the applicable purchase order number, quantity delivered, and unit price for each line item.

Each party shall treat as confidential all technical, commercial, and financial information disclosed by the other party in connection with this Agreement, and shall not disclose such information to any third party without the prior written consent of the disclosing party, except to employees, contractors, and advisors with a need to know and who are bound by confidentiality obligations no less protective than those set out herein. This obligation shall survive termination of this Agreement for a period of forty-five (45) days and shall not apply to information that is or becomes publicly available through no fault of the receiving party. The receiving party may disclose Confidential Information to the extent required by law or a valid order of a court or governmental authority, provided that, to the extent legally permissible, it gives the disclosing party prompt written notice of such requirement so that the disclosing party may seek a protective order or other appropriate remedy at its own expense.

A party affected by an event of force majeure shall promptly notify the other party of the nature and expected duration of the event, and shall be excused from performance, other than the obligation to make payments already due, for so long as the event of force majeure continues. Should an event of force majeure continue for a period exceeding ninety (90) days, either party may terminate this Agreement without liability by giving not less than 14 days' written notice to the other party, provided the event has not ceased prior to the expiry of such notice period. Neither party shall be entitled to terminate this Agreement for force majeure to the extent the affected party's own failure to maintain reasonable business continuity arrangements contributed materially to its inability to perform, and the parties shall cooperate in good faith to identify reasonable workaround arrangements before either party exercises any right of termination under this Clause.

All intellectual property rights in the calibrated pressure sensors, including any designs, drawings, specifications, or know-how provided by Buyer to Supplier for the purpose of manufacture, shall remain the exclusive property of Buyer, and Supplier shall acquire no rights therein other than the limited right to use such materials solely for the performance of its obligations under this Agreement. Supplier shall not use, reproduce, or disclose such materials for any other purpose without Buyer's prior written consent, and shall return or destroy all such materials within sixty (60) days of termination of this Agreement. Supplier shall ensure that any subcontractor engaged in the manufacture of the calibrated pressure sensors is bound by written obligations of confidentiality and restricted use no less protective of Buyer's intellectual property than those set out in this Clause, and Supplier shall remain fully liable to Buyer for any breach of this Clause by such subcontractor.

Supplier represents that it maintains a code of conduct consistent with generally accepted standards for responsible sourcing and shall not employ forced labor or child labor in the manufacture of the custom wiring harnesses. Supplier shall notify Buyer in writing within 10 days of becoming aware of any material non-compliance with applicable law in Singapore, and shall implement a corrective action plan within 30 days of identifying such non-compliance, subject to Buyer's reasonable approval. Buyer may, at its discretion and upon reasonable written notice, request evidence of Supplier's compliance with this Clause from any sub-tier supplier involved in the manufacture of the custom wiring harnesses, and Supplier shall use commercially reasonable efforts to obtain and provide such evidence within 10 days.

Supplier's aggregate liability under this Agreement shall be capped at 100% of the annual Contract Value; in no event shall Supplier be liable for consequential, incidental, or indirect damages of any kind arising out of or in connection with this Agreement, whether in contract, tort, or otherwise.

This Agreement shall terminate automatically, without notice, in the event either party becomes insolvent, makes an assignment for the benefit of creditors, or becomes subject to proceedings under applicable insolvency law that are not dismissed within 45 days. Upon termination for any reason, Buyer shall pay Supplier for all custom wiring harnesses delivered and accepted prior to the effective date of termination, and each party shall, within sixty (60) days, return or destroy any Confidential Information of the other party then in its possession. The provisions of this Agreement relating to confidentiality, intellectual property, and limitation of liability shall survive termination or expiration of this Agreement for any reason, together with any other provision that by its nature is intended to survive.

All shipments of custom wiring harnesses under this Agreement shall be packaged in accordance with Supplier's standard export packaging specifications, or such other specifications as the parties may agree in writing, and shall be accompanied by a packing list identifying the purchase order number, quantity, and batch or lot identifier. Supplier shall provide Buyer with advance shipping notification not less than 21 days prior to the scheduled ship date. Buyer shall inspect each shipment within forty-five (45) days of receipt and shall notify Supplier in writing of any discrepancy in quantity or apparent damage, failing which the shipment shall be deemed accepted as delivered. Supplier shall retain records of each shipment's packing list and carrier manifest for a period of not less than forty-five (45) days, and shall make such records available to Buyer upon reasonable written request for the purpose of resolving any delivery dispute. Title to rejected goods shall remain with Supplier pending disposition instructions from Supplier, which shall be provided within 21 days of receiving notice of rejection.
